description: This source file defines the Immigration Data Transfer Object (DTO) class in the Human Resource Management system. It extends a base DTO class, implements normalization of immigration records for an employee, and references other entities like Employee. It includes methods to convert data to an array and to specify getter methods for entity fields.

classes.name: Immigration
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for handling employee immigration records. It provides methods to serialize immigration data into an array format for reporting purposes, utilizing entity references and custom getter mappings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Immigration DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts immigration records of the associated employee into an array based on specified fields, using normalization and entity reference retrieval.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of field names to their respective getter methods or chains for retrieving data from Employee entities.
